'''Jorge''' was an actor in the pre-[[Great War|War]] era {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Jorge worked alongside [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]] as actors in the movie ''[[The Man from Deadhorse]]''. Jorge played a villain named Joey Toro, who ends up killed in the film's climax by Howard's character.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Head]]===
Jorge is seen on the film set of ''The Man from Deadhorse'' at [[California Crest Studios]] in a pre-War flashback. They are filming the climax of the film, where Jorge's character is on the ground, begging for his life from Cooper Howard's character, who is supposed to then shoot him. When Cooper breaks character, expressing discomfort with the scene, Jorge also breaks character and is seen looking around before Cooper offers him a hand and lifts him up off the ground. Jorge then walks away.

===[[The Ghouls]]===
In 2296, the Ghoul (Cooper) watches ''The Man from Deadhorse'' on a television in a [[Super Duper Mart (TV series)|Super Duper Mart]] along [[Santa Monica Boulevard]]. Jorge appears as his character, Joey Toro, in the climax of the film, and is seen being shot by Cooper's character.

==Appearances==
Jorge appears only in the ''Fallout'' TV series.
